posts.title: Week 427: Haunted toothbrush
posts.description: In the middle of the night last week, we were awoken by a strange noise in the bathroom. My Oral B electric toothbrush had turned itself on. Lachie leapt out of bed, unsure what the noise was but determined to find out. This is third time one of our toothbrushes has become haunted. Last time this happened to me was 2022.
